pure_absolute_python_path_difference.interpretation: Conservative environment invalidation is observed for this pure check; not proof arbitrary scripts can omit PATH.

unused_java_home_for_python.interpretation: Default environment set spans unrelated toolchains; env_keys only adds keys, cannot narrow.

same_absolute_python_dynamic_child.interpretation: Dropping PATH globally would remove a real causal input even with an absolute top-level interpreter.

unchanged_path_changed_child_bytes.interpretation: PATH value hashing is not nested-toolchain identity. Existing selected external inputs can bind the real child bytes; dynamic read-set completeness is not guaranteed.
